name: Graveknight
source: Pathfinder Monster Core, Graveknight (pg. 178), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=423
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Monster Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: For a living creature of at least 5th level. Increase its level by 1; attacks, AC, saves, Perception and skills by 1; HP by 5; Strike damage by 1. Becomes an unholy undead graveknight: darkvision, void healing, Rejuvenation, immunities (with its energy type), and the graveknight abilities (some swappable for alternates).
optional: It loses abilities that come from being a living creature, and traits of its life other than human, humanoid and the ancestries (removed here): remove those by hand, and adjust abilities that conflict with its theme. Ruinous Weapons: its Strikes get 1d6 of its energy type here; give them the striking rune's extra die by hand if they lack it. Betrayed Revivification changes its energy immunity, weapons and blast to mental: adjust those by hand.

choices.label: Energy type (relevant to its life or death)
Graveknight abilities
choices.note: The first five are standard; you can substitute one of them with an alternate below.

abilities.name: Sacrilegious Aura
abilities.description: 30 feet. When a creature in the aura uses a vitality spell or ability, {name} automatically attempts to counteract it, with a counteract modifier of {spellattack:high}.

abilities.name: Rejuvenation
abilities.description: When {name} is destroyed, its armor rebuilds its body over the course of 1d10 days—or more quickly if the armor is worn by a living host. If the body is destroyed before then, the process restarts. {Name} can only be permanently destroyed by obliterating its armor (such as with disintegrate), transporting it to the Forge of Creation, or throwing it into the heart of a volcano.

abilities.name: Devastating Blast
abilities.description: {Name} unleashes a 30-foot cone of energy. Creatures in the area take {area:limited} {opt:energy|lower} damage (DC {spelldc:high} basic Reflex save). {Name} can use this ability once every 1d4 rounds.

abilities.name: Phantom Mount
abilities.description: {Name} summons a supernatural mount, as marvelous mount heightened to rank {=max(1, level / 2)}. Unlike marvelous mount, the steed's AC is {=ac - 4}, its saving throw bonuses are 4 lower than {name}'s, and it has {=hp / 3} Hit Points. If the steed is destroyed, {name} must wait 1 hour before using this ability again.

abilities.name: Weapon Master
abilities.description: {Name} has access to the critical specialization effects of any weapons it wields.

abilities.name: Betrayed Revivification
abilities.description: {Name} died after being deeply betrayed. Instead of being immune to a type of energy damage, it's immune to mental damage, its weapons deal 1d6 additional mental damage, and its Devastating Blast deals mental damage with a Will saving throw instead of Reflex.

abilities.name: Channel Magic
abilities.description: {Name} redirects magical energies through its armor, allowing it to deliver magic through an attack. It Casts a Spell that takes 1 or 2 actions to cast and requires a spell attack modifier. The effects of the spell don't occur immediately but are imbued into an attack instead. {Name} then makes a melee Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack. The spell is coupled with the attack, using the attack roll result to determine the effects of both the Strike and the spell. This counts as two attacks for its multiple attack penalty but doesn't apply the penalty until after it has completed Channeling Magic. {Name} can't use Channel Magic again for 1d4 rounds.

abilities.name: Clutching Armor
abilities.description: Trigger A creature attempts to move away from {name}; Effect {Name}'s armor animates and attempts to Grab the triggering creature. It makes an Athletics check to Grapple with a +{=athletics - 2} modifier. The armor can continue to Grapple the creature normally. Since the armor is grappling the creature, {name} doesn't need a free hand to do so.

abilities.name: Create Grave Squire
abilities.description: {Name} can gift a piece of its armor to another creature, which becomes its grave squire. {Name} can communicate telepathically with its squire at any distance, see through the squire's senses, and cast suggestion as a divine innate spell through the telepathic link at will; the squire treats its degree of success as one step worse. If {name}'s main armor is destroyed, the squire's piece expands to cover the squire's body over 1d10 days, after which point it becomes {name}'s new body. {Name} can have only one squire at a time and must recover the armor piece to create a new squire.

abilities.name: Eager for Battle
abilities.description: When {name} rolls initiative, it rolls twice and takes the better result. It's quickened during its first round after rolling initiative and can use this extra action to Step, Stride, or Strike.

abilities.name: Empty Save for Dust
abilities.description: {Name}'s armor contains nothing more than swirling dust that puffs out from joints in its armor. A living creature that touches or is touched by {name} (including one hit by its fist Strike) must succeed at a DC {abilitydc} Reflex save or become contaminated with the dust. While contaminated, the creature is stupefied 1 and gains weakness {=max(1, level / 2)} to {name}'s {opt:energy|lower} damage. The contamination ends after 1 minute or when the creature is doused with water, whichever occurs first.

abilities.name: Graveknight's Shield
abilities.description: {Name}'s curse extends to its shield, or its armor uses a portion of itself to produce a shield. It has a shield that uses the statistics of a sturdy shield of level {=max(1, level - 1)} or lower. The shield is quasi-independent of {name} and automatically protects it from harm. When the shield is raised, it automatically uses Shield Block to reduce the damage of the first attack against {name} each round without {name} needing to spend its reaction to do so. The shield automatically rejuvenates with the rest of {name} and must be destroyed in the same manner as its armor.

abilities.name: Portentous Glare
abilities.traits: aura, divine, emotion, fear, mental, visual
abilities.description: 30 feet. {Name}'s visage is one of overwhelming menace. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it must attempt a DC {abilitydc} Will save. A creature that fails is doomed 1 (or doomed 1 and frightened 2 on a critical failure). {Name} can activate or deactivate the aura by using an Interact action to open or close its helmet visor.

abilities.name: Ruinous Weapons
abilities.description: Any weapon {name} wields or unarmed attack it uses gains the effects of {steps|a corrosive rune and a +1 striking rune|14=a greater corrosive rune and a greater striking rune}.

abilities.name: Ruinous Weapons
abilities.description: Any weapon {name} wields or unarmed attack it uses gains the effects of {steps|a frost rune and a +1 striking rune|14=a greater frost rune and a greater striking rune}.

abilities.name: Ruinous Weapons
abilities.description: Any weapon {name} wields or unarmed attack it uses gains the effects of {steps|a shock rune and a +1 striking rune|14=a greater shock rune and a greater striking rune}.

abilities.name: Ruinous Weapons
abilities.description: Any weapon {name} wields or unarmed attack it uses gains the effects of {steps|a flaming rune and a +1 striking rune|14=a greater flaming rune and a greater striking rune}.
